title.narrative: Construction of the Darakokaha-Kanawolo-Tafiré Highway Project (96.3 km)

description.narrative:
The development goals will contribute to economic growth by building sustainable infrastructure that supports international, regional and national connectivity, in line with the PND 2021-2025 to achieve economic growth over 7% per year for the next five years.
The specific project objectives are to improve the level of service and accommodate traffic growth along the A3 national and regional corridor linking the autonomous Port of Abidjan, a maritime entrance to Côte d'Ivoire, to the neighboring countries to the north without maritime facades, Burkina Faso and Mali.
The key results expected from the traffic growth and improved level of service are:
a. Travel time between Darakokaha and Tafiré reduced for light vehicles: from 73 minutes in 2024 to 50 minutes in 2030; Travel time between Darakokaha and Tafiré reduced for heavy goods vehicles: from 82 minutes in 2024 to 64 minutes in 2030;
b. VOC costs between Darakokaha and Tafiré for light vehicles: from 0.27 Euro/veh-km in 2024 to 0.26 Euro/veh-km in 2030. Reduction in VOC between Darakokaha and Tafiré for heavy goods vehicles: by 1.08 Euro/veh-km in 2024 for heavy goods vehicles at 0.88 Euro/veh-km in 2030.
c. Average Annual Daily Traffic (AADT) between Darakokaha and Kanawolo: from 2,900 veh/d in 2024 to 4,200 veh/d in 2030; TMAA between Kanawolo and Tafir
